title: ci: port the ui per-file test timings reporter and its dataset refresh, so CI can read Test UI file costs again (frozen since 2026-10-19)
body:
director#1 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg12BtjFc5rHp7YD1J

**Filing gate ③, a task the maintainer set by ruling.** #29469 ruling 6583487846 (batch #458 item 1, Q2 letter A, maintainer 「同意」). ⛔ Not a claim. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` seat; the PR touches `.github/workflows/**` (Tier H, the maintainer's approval).

## Why

`ui/scripts/test-shard-timings.json` holds per-file vitest timings from CI, last measured 2026-10-19 (six full-battery runs). The reporter that refreshed it was not carried over when `ui/` was imported (the comment above `Run the ui tests` in `ci.yml` says so). Since then CI cannot read Test UI file costs: the #25911 pilot's after-reading is NOT MEASURED in CI (#29469, 6582607393), the four rollout folds cannot be checked in CI, and Test UI shard balancing runs on stale data.

## Change

- Port the per-file timings reporter into the Test UI legs of `ci.yml` and the dataset refresh that rewrites `ui/scripts/test-shard-timings.json`, matching what the core legs already do for `scripts/test-shard-timings.json` (see PR #28978 for the core refresh).
- ⛔ A reporter and a dataset only: no new failing check, no threshold.

## Done when

A full-battery run on `main` writes fresh Test UI timings, and the dataset on `main` carries a measurement date after this card's filing.
